audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1] attribute Karma's only root to an 'RQ (Mantra Inner Flame) empowered snare.' The kit file shows Mantra+Q (Inner Flame) only adds a delayed damage cataclysm — no CC. The actual root is Focused Resolve (W): an unbroken tether roots the target, and Mantra strengthens that same W tether (heal + longer root), not Q. report[8].t and report[9].t misgendered Karma as 'his/His'; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit.
audit.why: Kit text is explicit: Q's Mantra bonus is damage-only; W's Mantra bonus extends the root. Directing a reader to dodge 'RQ' rather than the W tether sends them to watch the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Fixed spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1] to name the W tether as the root source, fixed both pronouns, added the tether's real 12s cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns, and fixed the two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
